home_desc:
This is a starter template built on PyQt6 + qfluentwidgets.
Add your own pages, register them in ui_main.py, and keep shared shell behavior in app_config.py and ui_utils.py.
settings_theme_desc: Choose light, dark, or follow the system theme.
settings_language_desc: Select interface language. Restart the app to apply translated navigation and page text.
settings_language_restart: Please restart the application for the language change to take effect.
about_desc: A clean desktop app template extracted from production PyQt6 + QFluentWidgets projects.
about_warn1: This template is intentionally generic. Replace project names, URLs, icons, and warnings before shipping.
about_warn2: Keep product-specific logic outside the template shell so future projects stay easy to clone.
